title: AI presenter: films in your own voice | Plainsight Medical
desc: An AI clone of the clinician, made with signed consent from one recording session, presents each patient film in the clinician’s own face and voice.

sections.text:
HOME
/
AI PRESENTER
YOUR FILMS, PRESENTED BY you.
We create an AI clone of you from one recording session. It appears on camera and narrates the whole film in your own voice, so patients meet the consultant they are about to see.

WITH YOUR AI PRESENTER
WITH OUR HOUSE NARRATOR
Dr Harmandeep Singh’s AI clone appears on camera, and his cloned voice narrates the whole film. Made for HeartLink, with his consent.

WHAT YOUR PRESENTER DOES
ONE SESSION. EVERY film.
On camera
Your digital twin introduces the film and returns for the key moments, in a clinic setting.
In your voice
Your cloned voice narrates the whole film, so the anatomy is explained by the consultant the patient will meet.
In every format
The full film, the vertical version and the shorts all carry your presenter.
STEP 01
Consent
You sign a consent form that sets out what your clone may be used for. Nothing is recorded before that.
STEP 02
One recording session
A single short session captures your face and your voice. It is the only time you are in front of a camera.
STEP 03
Your clone is built
We create a digital twin for the camera and a cloned voice for the narration.
STEP 04
Scripts you approve
Each script is drafted from NHS and NICE guidance. Your clone only speaks words you have reviewed and signed off.
STEP 05
Final sign-off
You see and hear the finished film before it is released, in every format.

CONSENT AND CONTROL
YOUR FACE AND VOICE STAY yours.
A clone of a clinician is only worth having if the clinician is in charge of it.
01
Your likeness stays yours
Your face and voice remain your own. The clone is not ours to use elsewhere.
02
Only your approved content
The clone is used for your films and nothing else.
03
Said on screen
Each film states that it is presented by an AI avatar, created with the clinician’s consent.
04
Stored securely
Your recordings and clone data are held securely and used only for your work.
05
Deleted on request
The clone is deleted when you ask, or when we stop working together.

QUESTIONS
BEFORE YOU decide.
BOOK A CALL
What do I have to do?
Who controls what my clone says?
Will patients know it is AI?
Does it replace me on camera completely?
What happens to my likeness if we stop working together?
